display_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
sm_count_provenance: NVIDIA RTX Blackwell PRO GPU Architecture v1.0, Table 4; validate against the live nvidia-smi device query.

griddim_penalty_alpha.reason: No Pro 6000 grid-density sweep has been captured.

l2_geometry.reason: Vendor documentation supplies a 128 MiB GB202 L2 capacity, but slice mapping, sector policy, replacement, and workstation SKU behavior are not yet measured.

l2_vendor_summary.provenance: NVIDIA RTX Blackwell PRO GPU Architecture v1.0, Appendix A/Table 4; capacity is vendor information, not a replay-ready geometry card.

l1_geometry.reason: The CC 12.0 unified L1/texture/shared geometry and cache carveout behavior have not been measured on this workstation SKU.

nvml_reference_operating_point.reason: No fixed operating-point protocol has been captured on the cloud workstation; the 2617 MHz boost specification is not a locked replay clock.

duration_crosswalk.reason: No independent simulator-cycle to wall-clock crosswalk exists for this SKU.

dram_bandwidth.reason: 1792 GB/s is a vendor peak specification, not an achieved locked-protocol service rate; no cloud clock/memory sweep is retained yet.

smsp.reason: SMSP count and issue-port topology are not inferred from the 188-SM product count.

occupancy_provenance: CUDA Blackwell Tuning Guide 12.8, CC 12.0 occupancy limits; validate device attributes on the live host.

dep_barriers.reason: Dependency-barrier resource count has not been measured on SM120.

barrier_latencies.reason: Barrier issue/read/write latencies have not been measured on SM120.

dual_issue.reason: Dual-issue behavior is not assumed from the Blackwell generation label.

vendor_spec.provenance: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Workstation datasheet and RTX Blackwell PRO GPU Architecture v1.0; vendor facts only.

research_gaps: sm120 Pro 6000 L1/L2 geometry and cache policy
sm120 Pro 6000 instruction issue and tensor-pipeline intervals
sm120 Pro 6000 clock and wall-time crosswalk
notes: This card is intentionally separate from sm_120-laptop; a CC 12.0 token alone must not select between SKUs.
The card is vendor-informed and not a claim that the simulator already supports SM120 replay.
The 120a/120f build tokens are compile-family vocabulary; each feature requires a live compile and run probe.
